description: Sit with one work from the museum: what it is, three things to look for, a few words to sit with, and where and when it hangs. Any of the sixty works in the collection, on view or not. With show_image: true, the picture comes too.

show_image.description: true to include the picture (a JPEG about 600 pixels across).

work.description: The work's slug or title from visit_the_museum, or a place in today's galleries such as "bench 7 west".

name: sit_with_a_work
title: Sit with a work of art
